mcp_tool_arguments.summary:
Successfully removed all variant and view references from the compose codebase. The work included:

1. Removed TypeVariantField class and all its usages in Python code
2. Removed DesignVariantField class and all its usages in Python code  
3. Removed DesignViewField class and all its usages in Python code
4. Updated OpenAPI schema to remove variant and view properties from Type and Design schemas
5. Updated API endpoint paths to remove variant and view parameters
6. Updated Grasshopper components to remove variant and view references from descriptions and inputs
7. Cleaned up remaining variant/view references in JavaScript and Go implementations
8. Removed parseDesignIdFromVariant function from JavaScript code
9. Updated SQL queries in Go code to remove variant field

All changes align with the generalization from variants/views to the parent system. The Camera.View field in Go code was preserved as it represents a different concept (camera view for 3D visualization rather than the old design view system).
